verdict.rationale: doola is an API-driven formation and compliance SaaS, so user-scheduled recurring jobs are a fair question for it, but the evidence shows no capability that lets a user define or schedule recurring jobs or workflows. The compliance calendar only lists recurring obligations that doola itself tracks, and annual-report notifications and Pulse bookkeeping automation are adjacent features, not user-configurable recurring schedules. Webhooks are event-driven, one-off callbacks, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
